annotations.title: Check a Motion video or Add effects

description: Free. Progress of one Motion video or Add effects request by its requestId; works after reconnecting. When ready it returns the Library asset id and an Open video link. A 15 s Motion video is usually ready in about 5 minutes and a 60 s one in up to about 15 minutes; Add effects usually takes a few minutes.

requestId.description: One id per owner approval, as the quote returned it: required to make and to check status; reuse the same one on any repeat.
